stem: If \(7a + i(3a - b) = 21 - 3i\) then find \(a\) and \(b\).
solution:
\(7a + (3a - b)i = 21 - 3i\)
By equality of complex numbers
\(7a = 21 \qquad \therefore a = 3\)
and \(3a - b = -3 \qquad \therefore 3(3) + 3 = b\)
\(\therefore 12 = b\)

By multiplying numerator and denominator with \(\overline{z_2} = 1 - i\)

stem: If \(a\) and \(b\) are real and \((i^4 + 3i)a + (i - 1)b + 5i^3 = 0\), find \(a\) and \(b\).
solution:
\((i^4 + 3i)a + (i - 1)b + 5i^3 = 0 + 0i\)
i.e. \((1 + 3i)a + (i - 1)b - 5i = 0 + 0i\)
\(\therefore a + 3ai + bi - b - 5i = 0 + 0i\)
i.e. \((a - b) + (3a + b - 5)i = 0 + 0i\)
By equality of complex numbers, we get
\(a - b = 0\) and \(3a + b - 5 = 0\)
\(\therefore a = b\) and \(3a + b = 5\)
\(\therefore 3a + a = 5\)
\(\therefore 4a = 5\)
\(\therefore a = \dfrac{5}{4}\)
\(\therefore a = b = \dfrac{5}{4}\)

stem: If \(x + 2i + 15i^6 y = 7x + i^3(y + 4)\) find \(x + y\), given that \(x, y \in R\).
solution:
\(x + 2i + 15i^6 y = 7x + i^3(y + 4)\)
\(\therefore x + 2i - 15y = 7x - (y + 4)i \qquad (\because i^6 = -1,\ i^3 = -i)\)
\(\therefore x - 15y + 2i = 7x - (y + 4)i\)
Equating real and imaginary parts, we get
\(x - 15y = 7x\) and \(2 = -(y + 4)\)
\(\therefore -6x - 15y = 0\) .... (i) \(\qquad y + 6 = 0\) ....(ii)
\(\therefore y = -6,\ x = 15\) [Solving (i) and (ii)]
\(\therefore x + y = 15 - 6 = 9\)
_note: This solved example is word-for-word the same question as Exercise 1.1 Q.24(v) on p-06 (printed p.7). Both are transcribed; they differ in framing/context so they will not dedup against each other. Flagged for the cross-check pass.
